panels.title: Compact aerial map → dash 09  |  Aircraft · Connected UE · gNB · HO flash
panels.description: A2G live map preview. Link to Live Aerial Track Map (uid atg-orbit). Aircraft: Prometheus markers (ADS-B tails only; cyan plane SVG). Connected UE: orange GeoJSON ue1..ue3 with ue_id + cell_id badge (OAI lab). Towers: serving gNB bright #39FF88 size=44px; neighbor towers dim #8C9AAF. Serving beams restricted to lab UEs only (lab_ues_only) — no ADS-B green starburst. Track/serving/sector/HO-flash layers are line-only. Map tooltips: aircraft / ground gNB / Connected UE only (single mode). HO live flash = white LineString for lab/OAI UEs only (≤5s, ≤150 km, #FFFFFF) — no modeled A3 ADS-B flashes, no persistent HO history markers on the map. Overlays: browser GeoJSON from http://localhost:9105/geojson/* (CORS-enabled). Not exporter:9105. HO OAI success/fail only when CU log tokens parse (lab `ci trigger_f1_ho` = signaling demo, not measurement-driven A3). Sionna twin RF when atg_pipeline_up{{component="sionna"}}=1; else need Sionna. Diona tiles = baseline example (diona_*), not live Diona RF.

panels.title: Altitude (ft) + slant range (km)
panels.description: atg_altitude_ft (left) + atg_slant_range_km (right). Geometry from ECEF slant (not flat-earth).
